_comment: D-009: Model-specific HP BIOS setting name overrides. Each key is an HP model name (as reported by Win32_ComputerSystem.Model), and each value maps canonical concepts to the setting names used by that specific model. The concepts are: network_boot, usb_boot, legacy_boot, boot_menu, fast_boot, f12_password. If a model is not listed here, the DEFAULT_SETTING_NAMES in hp_uefi_lockdown.py are used. To find the correct setting names for a new HP model, run: powershell "Get-WmiObject -Namespace root\hp\InstrumentedBIOS -Class HP_BIOSEnumeration | Select-Object Name, CurrentValue | Format-Table -AutoSize"

f12_password: Prompt for Admin password on F12 (Network Boot)
